newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy budget deficit cuts 37-38 trln lire - unions.
newsitem.headline: Italy budget deficit cuts 37-38 trln lire - unions.

text.p: The Italian government's 1997 budget will seek to cut between 37 to 38 trillion lire off next year's deficit, union leaders said after meeting Prime Minister Romano Prodi.

In addition, a special "Euro-tax", could raise up to 13 to 15 trillion lire, Sergio D'Antoni, head of the Cisl union, told reporters. The budget will be formally unveiled later on Friday, after a cabinet meeting which is due to start shortly.
